text:
marta: Drafting RN + internal blurb for tonight's EU midnight canary. Need ops + legal quick ACK.

marta: RN draft: "Model service: KV cache warmup reduces cold-start token latency (~30% p95). Canary will pin model v2.1.3; auto-fallback to v2.0.9 on overload. SDK: auth-header change is opt-in behind feature flag. Private EU customers: processing remains in EU per residency config."

samir: Added RN bullets: cache warmup metrics (warmup_ms, warmup_hits), pinned model v2.1.3, fallback v2.0.9, measured perf uplift, SDK opt-in note + link to SDK PR.

anya: Ops questions: propose rollback if error rate >=1.2% for 4m OR p95 latency >=1400ms for 3m. Canary plan: start at 3% traffic for 8m, then ramp to 15% if all green. I'll own the ramp.

marta: Slight wording tweak to RN and include SDK PR link. Samir, paste the link here.

samir: PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/423

marta: Deploy command we will run:
```
/deploy canary eu-1 --pin model:v2.1.3 --tag rn-2026-04-02b --traffic 3%
```
We'll add notes: "kv-warmup, sdk-flag" and route alerts to canary-alerts@pager.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rn-2026-04-02b for eu-1 at 2026-04-02T00:15:00Z; queued by marta. Reply with "ACK" to confirm standby.

anya: ACK 00. Monitoring dashboards wired, grafana panels ready. I'll annotate canary with "canary-checklist" tag.

legal-bot: legal-bot: automated check: EU residency clause present. Recommend explicit "in-region processing" phrase for clarity.

marta: Updated RN to: "Private EU customers: in-region processing and retention per configured residency settings." Lia, please confirm when you see this.

anya: One-line internal blurb for the channel (30m prior):
"Canary rn-2026-04-02b: model v2.1.3 -> 3% EU, ramp to 15% if healthy. Oncall: ops/anya, infra/samir. Rollback if errors >=1.2% (4m) or p95 >=1400ms (3m)."

samir: Ops playbook emergency fallback (to force traffic off and restore v2.0.9):
```
/deploy set-traffic eu-1 0% --target model:v2.0.9 --reason "canary emergency rollback"
```
Also add runbook steps to disable SDK flag if needed.

marta: All clear? Quick thumbs please so I can queue the internal announce.

anya: 👍 from ops.

samir: 👍 infra.

legal-bot: legal-bot: signed-off.

marta: Thanks team 1F scheduling preflight ping and will hit deploy-bot 30m before window. :rocket:
